scientific_guardrails: The exported values are source-reported optical-microscopy metrology values, not features re-extracted from raw micrographs.
The stable sample_id maps each reported transverse cross section to one NIST AMMT trace.
No process variable is stored or inferred in this producer bundle; process conditions belong to the consumer repository.
The bundle supports descriptive process-characterization integration after explicit identity validation, not causal attribution, optimization, prediction, or transfer beyond the benchmark conditions.
The reported within-measurement standard deviations are preserved and are not replaced by between-trace statistics.
